title: Empirical Explorations of the Geometry Theorem Machine
summary: Herbert Gelernter, J. R. Hansen and D. W. Loveland published a conference paper documenting empirical work with an IBM 704 geometry theorem-proving machine. The paper reports that the system had proved its first elementary Euclidean plane-geometry theorem in early spring 1959 and subsequently solved numerous textbook and examination problems.
significance: A dated primary-source documentation milestone for early machine theorem proving and symbolic problem solving. LINEAiGE records the 1960 publication and the historical claims explicitly stated in that paper; it does not treat the publication date as the system's invention date or infer broader priority, ancestry, influence, causality, or geography.
